post.description: Cancel a checkpointed run; no project write is implied by cancellation.
Restart a failed/cancelled run from fresh facts and retain its audit log.
Add one user answer and resume the same durable autonomous run.

AgentIntent.title: AgentIntent
AgentIntent.description:
Immutable user intent atoms plus explicit delegations.

``constraints`` contains only requirements, while subjective words such as
«плотно» belong in ``preferences``.  Normative policy is represented by a
policy-owned HardConstraint and is never generated as user text.

AgentRunState.title: AgentRunState
AgentRunState.description: Durable state restored after a process crash or human interruption.

CadSnapshotDependency.title: CadSnapshotDependency
CadSnapshotDependency.description: A package-local file whose exact bytes contributed native geometry.

CadSnapshotSelection.title: CadSnapshotSelection
CadSnapshotSelection.description: Exact native sidecar selected from the same allowlisted CAD root.

ControlCommand.title: ControlCommand
ControlCommand.description: Immutable server instruction bound to one source and execution attempt.

DataPassport.title: DataPassport
DataPassport.description: Evidence summary shown before an operator starts mass placement.

DataPassportEntry.title: DataPassportEntry
DataPassportEntry.description:
One source-data class and its role in the current calculation.

The passport is deliberately a compact audit contract.  It reports what
the importer can prove from the DXF and never treats an absent layer as an
empty physical area.

DxfTextEncoding.title: DxfTextEncoding
DxfTextEncoding.description: Browser TextDecoder labels for codecs supported by the DXF reader.

GrowthEnvelopeForecast.title: GrowthEnvelopeForecast
GrowthEnvelopeForecast.description: A bounded biological forecast, never a regulatory exclusion zone.

ImportMode.title: ImportMode
ImportMode.description:
How the current project's source was opened.

A plain DXF that contains Green Atlas planting layers is deliberately not
treated as an editable revision: without the release manifest those
circles are indistinguishable from existing vegetation.  A complete
release bundle carries the source and plan semantics needed to continue
editing safely.

message.title: Message
message.default: Исходный DXF доступен для подготовки редактируемого плана.

IntentEvidence.title: IntentEvidence
IntentEvidence.description:
Typed, user-visible semantic anchors used to audit compilation.

These are server-derived concept matches, not model reasoning.  They make
a correction explainable when a local model confuses a destructive action
with a placement request or drops one side of a mixed composition.

PlacementCheckRequest.title: PlacementCheckRequest
PlacementCheckRequest.description: The same candidate as Add, optionally bound to the caller's snapshot.

PlacementMaskRequest.title: PlacementMaskRequest
PlacementMaskRequest.description:
A repeatable, project-aware planting arrangement preset.

Masks describe an operator's spatial intent.  They only propose candidate
positions; the ordinary change-set preview remains the authority for every
statutory setback, occupied contour and plant-to-plant distance.

PlanValidationBasis.title: PlanValidationBasis
PlanValidationBasis.description: The inputs of derived issues; independent of the planting edit version.

site_conditions.description: Необязательная проверка одинаковых условий запроса: они должны совпадать с сохранёнными условиями каждого участка. Если поле не задано, используются независимые условия участков.

RegulatoryReleaseBasis.title: RegulatoryReleaseBasis
RegulatoryReleaseBasis.description:
Human-confirmed process basis attached to a final project revision.

This is deliberately not a claim that the service issued a permit.  It
makes the PP-616/PP-1160 decision explicit, attributable and auditable
before a package may be labelled final.

ResolvedScope.title: ResolvedScope
ResolvedScope.description: One authoritative scope chosen from explicit input or tool evidence.

source_index.title: Source Index
source_index.description: Index among parsed nonempty geometries of obstacle_kind in this geometry revision

nearest_features.title: Nearest Features
nearest_features.description: Up to 20 equidistant nearest source features in original order

SceneContextFeature.title: SceneContextFeature
SceneContextFeature.description: A lightweight, honest DXF footprint used as the 3D ground reference.

SceneEvidence.title: SceneEvidence
SceneEvidence.description: Provenance and coverage are separate from whether a value exists.

SceneVerticalPrimitive.title: SceneVerticalPrimitive
SceneVerticalPrimitive.description: Source-proven XYZ translated only in XY into the scene frame.

SelectionBinding.title: SelectionBinding
SelectionBinding.description: Source-selected subset and last explicitly accepted project revision.

SelectionContext.title: SelectionContext
SelectionContext.description: UI snapshot, never an instruction to select or expand a scope.

SiteConditions.title: SiteConditions
SiteConditions.description:
One homogeneous observation context for a working zone.

Unknown dimensions stay null; drainage and moisture are independent.
Zones keep independent observations; absent dimensions remain unknown.

UtilityContext.title: UtilityContext
UtilityContext.description: Explicit source interpretation; a layer-name guess is not confirmation.

VerificationSummary.title: VerificationSummary
VerificationSummary.description: Typed evidence that a preview is safe to present for approval.

ZoneSourceAmendment.title: ZoneSourceAmendment
ZoneSourceAmendment.description: A source message supplies one typed slot; earlier slots stay intact.
